raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Trunk change: needs line-by-line review. Continue #61201 at Kevin's request, replacing the per-file `find | xargs` wrapper with plain pytest and enrolling PyTorch Fullgraph plus its native mirror in automatic sharding.

This is the requested takeover of #61201, with the mirror enrolled too and the newer PaddleOCR-VL test kept isolated; it is not a separate competing fix.

## Claims

- Preserve the seven-file selection and exclusion of `test_full_cudagraph.py`.
- Reuse the existing planner, including parameter-case splitting for oversized files.
- Run affected fullgraph and multimodal tests with spawn so shuffled file groups do not fork inherited CUDA state (#28965).

## Validation

- Ruff check and format: passed on both changed Python files.
- `python tools/pre_commit/check_test_tethering.py --all`: passed; Selection parser confirms identical seven-file coverage.
- `split_check.py`: passed, no duplicate-suite parallel jobs.
- Generator command harness: 4 passed (base and mirror, PR and main/OTel shim); each simulated test runs exactly once.
- Generator comparisons: 6 passed for the PyTorch group (PR, main, nightly, run-all, scoped, AMD base-image change); only Fullgraph jobs change. Plans: 5 base shards and 3 mirror shards.
- [Scoped build 98528](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/98528): all eight shards passed without retries and stayed under the 20-minute target. Individual test IDs and outcomes match main build 98440 exactly: base 42 passed/1 skipped; mirror 30 passed/9 skipped; no missing or duplicate tests.
- [Scoped build 98556](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/98556), at head `8945b4f1543ad0b7d489f626ea67205cd3b156f5`: all five NVIDIA and three AMD shards passed. Longest jobs were 18m52s (NVIDIA) and 15m08s (AMD), including job setup and excluding queue time.
- Compared with [main build 98440](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/98440), aggregate job runtime increased from 65m07s to 67m01s on NVIDIA (about +1m55s total, +2.9%) and from 41m30s to 43m23s on AMD (about +1m52s total, +4.5%). This is a sampled cross-build comparison, not a controlled benchmark; the observed overhead is below two minutes per additional shard.
- Local mutation baseline blocked by missing vLLM test dependencies (`tblib`); no mutation-clean claim.
- Peer review: initial review found staging/comment issues, corrected; final review found no remaining issues.

## Details

Keep the existing per-job timeouts and rollback behavior. Retain Kevin's explicit spawn changes and apply the same isolation to the newer PaddleOCR-VL test. Job setup is reserved in the current planner's budget. The measured aggregate runtime comparison above includes repeated interpreter startup and cache effects.

No serving implementation or model-output behavior changes. Ready for human line-by-line review, with particular attention to the process-isolation changes.

AI assistance: Kevin's original changes were produced with Claude Code; Codex adapted them and ran local checks, with Claude peer review.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) and adapted with Codex.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Reuses the existing planner and process-isolation helper.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Current-head scoped GPU validation passed; local checks and measured runtime comparison described above.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Minimal test and CI configuration changes.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Takeover, tradeoffs and evidence stated above.
</details>
